name: wrap_individual
description: Wrap this precursor artifact into a baseline evolutionary Individual

form_config.name: source_node
form_config.label: Precursor Artifact
form_config.description: The artifact to start evolving from. It becomes the first exemplar of a new generation-0 individual, which keeps its settings (prompt, random seed and so on). A gen-0 genome changes nothing yet, so the individual sounds like the unmodified model until you scatter it.

form_config.name: lora_rank
form_config.label: LoRA Rank
form_config.description: How many independent directions each layer can change in. Every linear layer of the model gets an adapter of this rank, fixed for the whole lineage. Rank 1 keeps changes simple and focused; higher ranks allow richer changes. Mutation Strength means the same at every rank.
